name: session-status
description: Two independent modules that surface a Claude Code session state outside the terminal: an icon in the tab, a sound.

plugins.name: status-icons
plugins.description: Marks the terminal tab with an icon that tells "it is done" apart from "it is blocked on you", where Claude Code shows the same star for both.

plugins.name: status-sounds
plugins.description: Plays a short sound when Claude has finished, has failed, or wants something from you — so you look up at the right moment without watching the tab.
